The '''Defeat of the Starweird Queen''' was a battle between the [[Starweird/Legends|Starweird]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. For unknown reasons, the Starweird, guided by their leader, the [[Starweird Queen]], decided to use the war as a excuse to annihilate the Jedi and eventually all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. To achieve this end, the Starweird Queen attempted to kill the majority of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], along with the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xerender]]. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wyellett]], who had fought and won many battle during the war, sacrificed himself in order to save the Council and his Padawan. Due to his sacrifice, Wyellett was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After he was captured, his prison ship was shot down in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]].
